senses.sense_definition: A smaller system that represents or reflects the characteristics of a larger one.

examples.text: The small village is a <w>microcosm</w> of the entire country's social and political struggles.
This school serves as a <w>microcosm</w> of the diverse city in which it is located.

senses.sense_definition: A small, controlled natural environment used for scientific study or experimentation.

examples.text: Researchers created a <w>microcosm</w> in the lab to observe how the pond life reacts to pollution.
The scientists monitored the <w>microcosm</w> to understand the long-term effects of climate change on local species.

senses.sense_definition: The human being viewed as a miniature reflection of the universe or divine nature.

examples.text: Ancient philosophers often described man as a <w>microcosm</w> containing the essence of the stars.
The idea that the human body is a <w>microcosm</w> was central to many medieval medical theories.

traits.comment: Used primarily in historical or philosophical contexts.

senses.sense_definition: The human body or an individual person.

examples.text: The poet referred to his own <w>microcosm</w> as a vessel for his wandering soul.
In this literary work, the author explores the fragility of the human <w>microcosm</w> against the vastness of time.

traits.comment: Used in literary or archaic contexts.
